verdict.rationale: Appwrite is self-hostable (full data control, Docker-based) and has a CLI that can list/export resources (users, files, rows) via JSON, plus is open-source, which together enable a path to export data and migrate away in open formats. However, there's no explicit documented 'export all data' feature or bulk-export/backup tool, nor open-format guarantees for all data types (e.g., storage files, function code, DB schema) in one operation. missing for 10: a dedicated bulk data-export/backup command or documented full-project export in open formats, explicit data-portability guarantees, and independent confirmation of a clean full account/data export.
